toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create the complete self-contained HTML demo requested: realtime rotating Gouraud shaded cube exclusively Canvas 2D, no libraries or external assets. Attractive dark navy full-window presentation with small title, explanation, FPS counter, W wireframe and P pause keyboard shortcuts plus clickable accessible buttons. All CSS JS inline. Compute Lambert lighting at each transformed vertex from a moving point light vector normalized(light-position), ambient + diffuse, optionally colored face materials combined with each vertex intensity; interpolate colors perspective-correctly with barycentric color/z divided by interpolated 1/z for genuinely smooth Gouraud faces. Camera safely away from cube so no near-plane issues. Orbiting light with visible projected warm glow marker drawn via 2D gradient after cube and simple LIGHT label, omit marker if behind cube using depth check if convenient. Wireframe toggles visible face edges and triangle diagonals after rasterization (only culled visible faces, so no hidden-face lines), normal rendering remains. Animation uses requestAnimationFrame elapsed delta clamped, time stops when paused but render loop/FPS continues, update FPS about every .4 sec. Resize handler maintains internal/render surface size and projection aspect; no excessive devicePixelRatio allocation.
